mapper.delete: DELETE FROM source_classification_raw WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND scheme = #{scheme}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_classification_raw (source_id, scheme, code, label, share, rank) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{o.scheme}, #{o.code}, #{o.label}, #{o.share}, #{o.rank}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, scheme, code) DO UPDATE SET label = EXCLUDED.label, share = EXCLUDED.share, rank = EXCLUDED.rank, fetched = now()
mapper.select: SELECT scheme, code, label, share, rank FROM source_classification_raw WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY scheme, rank, code
